name: Sepúlveda (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Sepúlveda (a castle between two keys on red).
history: Municipal flag of Sepúlveda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
